criteria_scope: Frozen integer thresholds apply separately to every seed; all criteria are ANDed. No checkpoint or seed was selected by its score.

question_counts.note: Checkpoint and seed repetitions are not new independent questions.

costs.timing_note: Trajectory sums and evaluator elapsed time describe these recorded scopes; they are not end-to-end research walltime or a causal efficiency comparison.

replay_verification.scope: Only seed101 full replay; no new independent student.

report.scope: Independent raw-array free/TF inference on first/last row per split/N/r at all18 checkpoints; archived state/replay/file bindings and full eval cost arithmetic. No training or parameter search. Other prediction rows are not independently re-inferred.

selection.rule: First and last dataset row in every split/N/r cell

limitations: One fixed curriculum arm and three seeds do not establish curriculum superiority or research-workflow speedup.
All data use fixedn5 and familiar ordinary IDs. Heldout means untrained complete payload question combinations, not all-role novel content.
Only N4 has count contrasts; N2r1 and N3r1/r2 are outside this run.
TF count-boundary success is a conditional prediction diagnostic, distinct from autonomous whole-answer success.
Only seed101 received full training replay; seed202/303 were not fully retrained for verification.
This exporter recomputes metrics from saved outputs and verifies their file provenance; it does not independently rerun neural inference or inspect checkpoint arrays.
